subject: APAC mini-pool reserve request & SOW — Nebula Labs
messages:
From: Ethan Zhou <ethan@nebulalabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot capacity ask — APAC mini-pool request

Hi Jordan,

Quick intro — I lead platform at Nebula Labs. We're ramping a customer-facing feature that needs predictable inference capacity in APAC (Singapore) for an initial pilot starting mid-August. We expect burst profiles of ~60 rps peak, steady-state ~12 rps, with median sequence lengths ~256 tokens.

Ask: can Redwood provide a dedicated APAC mini-pool (reserved capacity) sized for this pilot for 3 months? We're prepared to sign an SOW for a committed monthly spend but need the node count and lead time from you to finalize our procurement calendar.

Constraints: data residency in SG, KMS-backed keys, SOC2 evidence will be requested.

If helpful I can share sample traffic curves and a short runbook. We're eager to move quickly — are you able to give sizing and an SOW draft by EOD Monday?

Thanks,
Ethan Zhou
Head of Platform, Nebula Labs
procurement@nebulalabs.com
[Attachment: pilot_traffic_sample.csv (csv)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Pilot capacity ask — APAC mini-pool request

Ethan — thanks for the details and the traffic sample. Looping in Ben (sales ops) and Irene (infra) to size and draft the SOW. Grace — FYI on procurement path and discounts for short pilot commits.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben to produce a node-level sizing + rough cost to hit the 60rps burst and 12rps steady profile.
- Irene to validate SG availability and recommend GPU SKUs (and lead times).
- I will send a concise SOW + timeline for signature so Nebula can hit mid-August.

Ethan — I plan to get back with a first-pass by Monday COB PT. If mid-Aug matters more than the exact SLO, say so and we'll prioritize a temporary fallback in EU while APAC is provisioned.

—Jordan

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ethan Zhou <ethan@nebulalabs.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot capacity ask — APAC mini-pool request

Jordan / team — attached is a first-pass capacity estimate based on Ethan's traffic sample. Key assumptions and recommendation below.

Assumptions (from sample):
- Peak 60 rps sustained for short bursts (5–10 minutes), median seq 256 tokens, 95th percentile seq ~600 tokens.
- Model: customer intends to use a 13B dense model (inference profile similar to Red13B).

Sizing (APAC mini-pool):
- Recommended reserved footprint: 4x A100-80GB equivalent nodes (configured for continuous batching)
- Expected steady throughput: ~12 rps at p95 with <120ms network+queue latency per request when pooled
- Burst handling: can absorb 60rps with autoscale-burst to 8 nodes (burst pool reserved as commit or billed as on-demand).

Cost / commercial notes:
- Monthly committed SKU estimate (4 reserved nodes): USD 63,200/month (includes reserved discount + network egress allowance).
- Optional burst buffer (2 nodes on-demand) estimate: additional ~USD 8,400/month if left reserved; billed otherwise by usage.

Deliverables attached: capacity_estimate_apac.xlsx (node-level math), and a short SOW template (Nebula_SOW_v1.pdf) with the pilot term (3 months) and deliverables.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: capacity_estimate_apac.xlsx (spreadsheet), Nebula_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ethan Zhou <ethan@nebulalabs.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Jul 2028 01:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot capacity ask — APAC mini-pool request

Thanks — a few infra constraints and recommendations before we commit.

Availability & lead times:
- Singapore region: immediate availability for 2 A100-equivalent nodes. Additional capacity currently has a 3–5 week ramp depending on partner inventory.
- If Nebula needs a strict mid-Aug start, we can:
  1) Reserve 2 nodes in APAC and front-load 2 nodes in EU (Frankfurt) with cross-region routing until APAC nodes come online.
  2) Offer an accelerated provisioning path (expedite fee) to shift inventory — requires approval from procurement and ops (timeline 7–10 days).

Recommended GPU profile:
- Primary: A100-80GB (or equivalent 80GB SXM) for model memory headroom at 256–600 token runs.
- If cost reduction is necessary and accuracy/latency allows: mixed fleet with 2x A100 + 2x 40GB triton-quant nodes (saves ~18% cost but increases memory spill risk).

Operational notes (KMS / SOC2):
- KMS integration is straightforward; we need Nebula to supply a customer-managed key policy and contact.
- SOC2 evidence packet is ready to share; I'll circulate the standard checklist after SOW countersign.

Action items: Jordan — please indicate whether Nebula prefers the expedite fee or EU-fallback path. I'll hold final reservations pending that call.

Irene Choi
Head of Infra — Redwood Inference

Ethan — thanks for your patience. Summary & proposed path to meet mid-Aug start: 

Summary of proposal:
- Reserve 2x A100-80GB nodes in SG immediately (available now).
- Reserve additional 2x A100-80GB nodes on accelerate provisioning (expedite fee) to be online within 7–10 days.
- Nebula signs 3-month pilot SOW (attached) and accepts an optional 2-node burst buffer in on-demand pricing (recommented to handle rare >60rps spikes).

Commercials & next steps:
- SOW link for signature: https://docusign.net/nebula-sow-NB12487
- HubSpot deal for reference: https://hubspot.company/deal/NB-12487
- Ben: please convert the attached SOW into a DocuSign envelope with the expedite option flagged and the pricing lines shown.
- Irene: once Ben confirms, please place node reservations (2 immediate + expedite 2) and confirm expected activation window.

Ethan — can you confirm by EOD Tuesday PT whether Nebula accepts the expedite fee or prefers EU-fallback? If you accept expedite, I'll move the DocuSign and reservations today.

Thanks — Jordan
